'''2007 Texas State Championship Thomas Schroeder DS Cloud City: Port Town District''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Schroeder]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Lost in the Clouds
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
